# - Ethanol / Lactate / Alanine (fermentation): Fermentation needs hypoxia. LunarLeaf-CFD T8 puts BRIC O2 depletion at 6.5 days and only in DARK canisters; OSD-522 is BRIC-LED, illuminated, where photosynthesis releases O2. No hypoxia is predicted, so no fermentation products are predicted.
